paper.title_en: Exact algebraic separation of the gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of Kerr-Newman-(anti-)de Sitter black holes
paper.abstract_en: We obtain an explicit separation of the coupled gravitational and electromagnetic radiative equations on nonextremal Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter black holes with nonzero charge and rotation. The construction uses a matrix with constant determinant, chosen independently of the frequency and azimuthal number, and treats the positive- and negative-spin sectors within the same formulation. We establish that this transformation is smooth and invertible throughout the open AdS exterior and between the event and cosmological horizons in dS. The resulting radial and angular systems are valid at arbitrary complex frequencies. We also express regularity of the radiative Newman--Penrose variables at the rotation axes and future horizons as conditions on the separated solutions. In the asymptotically flat limit, the transformation is related to Hintz's matrix integrating factor by the allowed frame freedom. These results provide a basis for studying quasinormal modes and black-hole stability in Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter spacetimes, as well as exploring holographic applications to strongly coupled systems.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文给出了Kerr-Newman-(反)de Sitter黑洞耦合引力电磁微扰的显式代数分离，方法新颖且具有理论深度，并覆盖渐近平坦极限与全息应用，适合作为该索引中值得点击深入阅读的候选。
decision.title_zh: Kerr-Newman-(反)de Sitter黑洞引力电磁微扰的精确代数分离
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在具有非零电荷与旋转的非极端Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter黑洞上，获得了耦合的引力与电磁辐射方程的显式分离。该构造使用一个行列式为常数的矩阵，其选择与频率及方位角数无关，并在同一表述中处理正自旋与负自旋扇区。我们证明该变换在整个开放的AdS外部区域以及在dS情形下事件视界与宇宙学视界之间是光滑且可逆的。所得的径向系统与角向系统在任意复频率下均有效。我们还将辐射Newman--Penrose变量在旋转轴与未来视界处的正则性，表述为对分离解的条件。在渐近平坦极限下，该变换通过允许的标架自由度与Hintz的矩阵积分因子相关联。这些结果为研究Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter时空中的准正规模与黑洞稳定性提供了基础，也为探索对强耦合系统的全息应用提供了基础。
